messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: INC-AGW-502-spike for api-prod-east — severity P1. Elevated 5xx (502/504) inbound ~12% over the last 3m. Autoscaling alerts firing. Link: https://dash.redwood/incident/INC-AGW-502-spike

alice: I'm on-call and looking. Starting quick triage now. Which routes are reporting the highest error shard? @ben can you grab ingress mux logs and recent config diffs? :rotating_light:

ben: on it. pulling ingress/mux logs and apigw metrics. Quick grep shows lots of `upstream prematurely closed connection` from mux -> model-service-proxy between 03:18-03:28. Sample log: ```[03:22:11] error: upstream prematurely closed connection (502) while reading response header from upstream```

carol: also seeing a spike in connection resets and keepalive timeouts at the edge. Backend pod CPU/memory look normal but connection count for model-svc pods is hitting connection_pool_max. Possible connection pool exhaustion after the new mux throttle rule rolled out at 03:15.

dan: I can temporarily reduce fanout and route heavy clients to the fallback pool. Planning to annotate route for low-fanout: `kubectl annotate svc api --overwrite fanout=low` then trigger config reload. Will run a staged change.

eve: Deploy-bot: Detected manual mux config change at 2026-03-17T03:15 by ops-tooling (change id: cfg-20260317-0315). Rolling back config change now as requested by dan. Rollback job started: job/rollback-cfg-20260317-0315 (ETA ~30s).

ben: After rollback start (03:31) error rate dropped from 12% -> 5% in the aggregated metric within one window. Still seeing ~2-3% errors concentrated on long-poll endpoints (token-generation).

alice: Good catch. Next steps: 1) keep rollback, 2) increase keepalive and connection pool for model-svc, 3) scale model-svc replicas by +2. I'm applying patches: `kubectl patch deployment model-svc -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"model","env":[{"name":"KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT","value":"75s"}]}]}}}}'` and `kubectl scale deployment model-svc --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy model-svc -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+2))`.

carol: Applied a temporary ingress keepalive increase on the mux (60s -> 120s) and bumped connection pool threshold on the proxy. Monitoring tail of logs.

ben: Metrics update: error rate now 1.8% aggregated, 95th latency trending down. The subset of affected customers (high concurrency streaming) still have intermittent 502s but traffic has significantly stabilized.

dan: I've enabled a traffic-shift to fallback pool for the top 3 noisy customers to reduce pressure while we validate config changes. Commands: `trafficctl shift --service api --clients clientA,clientB,clientC --target fallback-pool`

eve: Noted customer-impact: clientA experienced ~30% failed requests during the 03:15-03:32 window. Customer success notified and opened CS ticket #CS-3128. Will prepare external comms if trend recurs.

alice: Logging this as mitigated — pager cleared locally. We should keep monitoring for 15m and capture full timeline for postmortem. Assigning initial owner for follow-up: @carol to own post-incident writeup and remediation plan.

ben: Quick artifact: screenshot of time series + query used: `sum(rate(api_gateway_responses{code=~"5.."}[1m])) by (route)` and a sample `nginx` error snippet included in incident doc.

carol: Root cause hypothesis: newly deployed mux throttle config reduced connection reuse, increasing new connection churn and exhausting upstream connection pools -> upstream resets -> 502/504 fanout. Remediation actions: revert config (done), increase pool/keepalive (done), add pre-deploy validation rule to run connection-stress test against staging mux config, and add an alert on connection_pool_utilization >= 80%.

alice: Great. I'll mark as resolved in the incident channel once metrics hold for 15 minutes. Thanks everyone for the fast ops. :white_check_mark:

eve: Deploy-bot: Rollback completed successfully at 2026-03-17T03:32:12. Job log: https://deploy.redwood/jobs/rollback-cfg-20260317-0315

carol: Monitoring 15m window... if no regressions, we'll convert to postmortem and remediation tasks.

alice: last check 03:42 — error rate steady at ~1.2%. Closing incident and creating postmortem stub. Will sync with CS on customer timeline.

incident-bot: Incident INC-AGW-502-spike marked resolved by alice at 1746810600. Summary: rollback of mux config + connection pool tuning reduced 5xx spike. Follow-up: postmortem assigned to carol, CS ticket CS-3128 for clientA.
